extracted.intended_audience: early-career researchers and academics who want training and certification in performing peer review
extracted.subtask_description: Introductory course syllabus and resource list describing modules and expectations for becoming a certified peer reviewer, including core topics (what peer review is, models, process), practical skills (writing reports, handling invites, recommending decisions), and assessment for certification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Introduction to the Certified Peer Reviewer Course
rubrics_metrics.description: Live introduction describing what the Certified Peer Reviewer course will offer, the time commitment required, and expected outcomes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains that by taking the course you will receive a thorough grounding in the principles and practice of refereeing; gives information about course creators and the syllabus.

rubrics_metrics.name: What is peer review? Why peer review? (1.1)
rubrics_metrics.description: Module covering the definition, purpose and rationale for peer review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides foundational grounding on the role and importance of peer review in research evaluation (module 1.1 in the syllabus).

rubrics_metrics.name: Models of peer review (1.2)
rubrics_metrics.description: Module introducing different models of peer review (e.g., blind/double-blind, open peer review, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers comparative overview of peer review models; linked downloads (e.g., double-blind guidelines) provide more detail.

rubrics_metrics.name: The typical peer review process (1.3)
rubrics_metrics.description: Module describing the standard workflow and stages of how manuscripts move through peer review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains the sequence of events and actors in peer review to orient reviewers to expectations and timing.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to get involved (1.4)
rubrics_metrics.description: Module about routes and strategies for becoming involved as a peer reviewer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical advice aimed at early-career researchers on how to register interest, build reviewer experience, and engage with journals.

rubrics_metrics.name: I just got a review invite, what’s next? (2.0)
rubrics_metrics.description: Module focused on the immediate steps a reviewer should take upon receiving an invitation to review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers decision points and initial checks (e.g., suitability, conflicts, time commitment)—presented as the course's 'what to do next' guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to write a helpful peer review report (3.1)
rubrics_metrics.description: Module on composing constructive, useful peer review reports for authors and editors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Central practical module teaching how to structure feedback, balance critique with constructive suggestions, and deliver clear actionable comments.

rubrics_metrics.name: The comments to editors and decision recommendations (3.2)
rubrics_metrics.description: Module addressing how to frame confidential comments to editors and how to make decision recommendations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers the distinction between public author-facing comments and private editor-facing advice, and guidance on recommending accept/revise/reject decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Certified Peer Reviewer Course Assessment
rubrics_metrics.description: Assessment component of the course that evaluates learners' understanding and grants certification upon successful completion.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implied requirement to complete modules and pass the assessment to obtain certification; progress tracked (e.g., 0/12).

rubrics_metrics.name: How to peer review a review article (3.3)
rubrics_metrics.description: Module on the specific considerations and standards when reviewing review-type manuscripts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses differences between reviewing original research and review articles (scope, comprehensiveness, synthesis quality).

rubrics_metrics.name: Certified Peer Reviewer Course Syllabus (download)
rubrics_metrics.description: Downloadable syllabus outlining course structure, modules, and time commitment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Primary document detailing course content and organization (opens in new window).

rubrics_metrics.name: Double-blind peer review guidelines (download)
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidelines detailing the practices and expectations for double-blind peer review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides rules and recommendations relating to anonymity, manuscript anonymization, and reviewer/editor responsibilities under double-blind models.

rubrics_metrics.name: Elsevier editors share their top reviewing tips - Part 1 (download)
rubrics_metrics.description: Collected tips from Elsevier editors on best practices for reviewers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Editor perspectives on what they expect from reviewer reports and common pitfalls to avoid.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reviewer's quick guide to common statistical errors in scientific papers (download)
rubrics_metrics.description: Practical checklist/guide for spotting and evaluating common statistical errors during review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Helps reviewers assess statistical validity and identify frequent methodological/statistical issues in manuscripts.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to review manuscripts (download)
rubrics_metrics.description: General practical guidance on reviewing manuscripts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Step-by-step advice and considerations for assessing manuscripts across disciplines (opens in new window).

rubrics_metrics.name: Peer review - The nuts and bolts (download)
rubrics_metrics.description: Practical resource outlining core mechanics and expectations of peer review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers operational aspects of peer reviewing and actionable advice for reviewers.

rubrics_metrics.name: The importance of diversity in peer review (download)
rubrics_metrics.description: Resource discussing why diversity matters in peer review and how to promote it.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses equity, inclusion, and how diversity in reviewer pools improves review quality and fairness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reviewer Hub / Additional resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Collection of further resources including Reviewer Hub, advisory board & speaker information, and Peer Review Week materials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Signposts to broader institutional resources, community events, and governance/advisory information relevant to reviewers.
